snippet.title: My Player 26 - Official Trailer (Mobile)
snippet.description:
Discover the new teaser for My Player 26 on mobile 🔥

Create your own player, climb the rankings, and dominate the court in a mobile tennis experience built around your journey.

With career progression, RPG elements, and 3D matches, step into the world of professional tennis and shape your own path to the top.

📆 Available on May 12 on iOS & Android

Start with the free trial, then unlock the full version to enjoy the complete experience.

Pre-register now:
Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ReboundCG.TennisManager2026
AppStore: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tennis-manager-26-my-player/id6761369258

Follow us:
